correctness.rationale: The logit inverse locates the interior equilibrium. The Jacobian has positive determinant and strictly positive trace crossing at an interior Hopf. Exact logistic third derivatives, canonical rotation coordinates, and the planar radial cubic formula give the signed closed coefficient. Its factorization and payoff inequalities prove the all-parameter signs, and the explicit rational-payoff witness has \(0<N<1\) and a speed threshold strictly between 315 and 316. A standalone high-precision checker recomputes the unreduced derivatives and confirms both signs. No Bautin or global claim is made.
